_doc: Third-party ratings and review excerpts shown on the site (RTB). Excerpts are verbatim and short, always attributed and linked to the source; read in full on the platform. Rule from the founder: never use reviews written by anyone named Aleks or a derivative (Alex, Alexander, Aleksandr, Alexei, Oleksandr, Alessandro, Sasha, Sascha...) - build.py also filters them out. Only positive excerpts (what the reviewer likes / the problem it solves). Update ratings and counts when the platforms change; 'checked' is the date they were last read.
